verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented training opt-out or data-usage policy for Mistral's hosted API or Le Chat. The only route to keeping data out of training is indirect: the pricing page says you can self-host the open-weight models anywhere, so data never reaches Mistral, and a community post notes EU companies use Mistral for local/self-hosted deployment because of data concerns. Missing for 10: a documented training opt-out for hosted API/Le Chat users, a published data-retention/no-training policy, and independent corroboration of how hosted data is handled.
